items.title: Channel stats, like Anope's
items.text: ChanServ SET #chan CHANSTATS ON and NickServ SET CHANSTATS ON (both off by default) count lines, words, letters, smileys, actions, kicks, mode changes and topics per person, for today, this week, this month and all time; ChanServ STATS, TOP, TOP10, GSTATS, GTOP and !stats, !top, !top10 in the channel show them, and the Anope import brings old stats switches over.

items.title: Hive Panel
items.text: A Stats tab on My channels (top 10, the channel's totals and its stats switch) and "Count me in channel stats" on My nick.

items.title: New [services] max_accounts_per_email
items.text: Limit how many accounts may use one email address (0 = no limit, the default).

items.title: New [services] help_channel
items.text: People with op in that channel get helper mode +h automatically.

items.title: New OperServ OLINE <nick> +flags|-flags
items.text: Give someone on this server oper flags until they quit (only flags you have yourself).
